text:
julie (DevRel): Quick sync — RefApp Lite OSS launch plan + community hacknight + benchmark blog. Need alignment on messaging, webinar format, and how inbound leads get routed to sales. Goal: week-of launch promotion and a small developer event the following week.

owen (Growth): Love it. Two quick asks: 1) overarching benchmark narrative (what do we want to prove vs hosted incumbents?), 2) lead scoring/tags for registrants.

julie (DevRel): Benchmark narrative suggestion: "how much you can save at 95th percentile latency with smart batching + prefix cache." show cost/TCO and a simple latency table for typical prompt lengths. Emphasize predictable throughput not just best-case numbers.

maya (PMM): For marketing copy: audience = platform engineers evaluating hosted vs dedicated. Tone = pragmatic, numbers-first. We should ship a 1-pager + TL;DR tweet thread + demo GIFs.

ben (Growth): For the webinar/hacknight — keep it interactive. 20m demo, 20m hands-on breakout (small tasks in the repo), 20m Q&A. Use a registration form that captures company size + infra interest.

ana (typo) sorry — meant ana (Eng): We can freeze a "demo-ready" branch tomorrow. Need 48h for final perf runs (bench script lives in scripts/bench/run.sh). I'll add a reproducible perf gist.

kevin (Sales Ops): Routing plan proposal: set HubSpot property "lead_source = refapp_lite" and "event = refapp_hacknight_may25" on registration. Then a workflow: if company_size >= 250 OR interest = "enterprise" -> assign to AE queue "OSS Inbound", else to SDR nurture sequence. Can share the exact workflow JSON.

sara (Legal): Quick check: any open-source licensing notes or logo co-branding? If we reference competitor numbers, make sure claims are verifiable or marked as internal benchmark.

julie (DevRel): Good call. We'll add a footnote: "benchmarks run with model X on g4dn-equivalent; see repo for scripts and raw data." Legal okay?

sara (Legal): That wording is fine. Also include a short CONTRIBUTING.md blurb about acceptable external benchmarks.

owen (Growth): Asset list for launch checklist: landing page, registration form, 1-pager PDF, bench blog draft, 2 GIFs (demo short clips), 1 minute promo video, PR to repo (README update + release notes), tweet thread + LinkedIn copy, email sequence for registrants.

maya (PMM): I'll draft the bench blog outline today. Need the bench numbers by EOD tomorrow. Can someone drop the CSV to the shared folder?

ana/ana (Eng): Will upload csv + raw logs to gdrive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-FAKE-REFAPP-BENCH. Also pushing the demo branch to github: https://github.com/redwood/refapp-lite/tree/demo-ready.

ben (Growth): Example UTM + HubSpot fields (paste into registration form devs):
```
utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=refapp_lite_launch
hubspot_meta: lead_source=refapp_lite, event=hacknight_may25, campaign=refapp_lite_launch
```
Make sure HubSpot form sets those hidden fields.

kevin (Sales Ops): I'll create the HubSpot workflow. Quick snippet for the Owner assignment rule (pseudo):
```
if company_size >= 250 OR interest contains "enterprise" -> Owner = "oss_inbound"
else -> Owner = "oss_nurture"
create task: "Qualify RefApp Lite registrant" assign to Owner
```

julie (DevRel): Who's the run-of-show owner for the hacknight? Need rehearsals + breakout facilitators.

ben (Growth): I can own run-of-show. Volunteers for breakout leads: ana (Eng), maya (PMM), julie (DevRel).

ana/ana (Eng): happy to lead one breakout. I'll prepare two small issues labeled "hack-task" in the demo repo.

maya (PMM): For the blog headline options: "RefApp Lite: Production-grade inference patterns for predictable cost and latency" or shorter: "RefApp Lite — predictable LLM inference, open source." Prefer the shorter one for social. Thoughts?

owen (Growth): Shorter is better on social. The longer is good for the blog H1.

julie (DevRel): Timeline (T = launch day):
- T-14: publish landing + registration + repo PR with README preview
- T-10: bench blog draft + internal review
- T-7: promotional assets (GIFs, 60s video) ready
- T-3: rehearsal + send reminder sequences
- Launch day: blog + landing + tweet thread + send press/partners note
- T+7: hacknight event

ben (Growth): Can we add an opt-in checkbox on reg form for "share my contact with Sales" (required to route to AE). Also need GDPR copy.

kevin (Sales Ops): yes. Add boolean field share_with_sales. Workflow only assigns owner when share_with_sales == true or company_size >= 250. Will implement.

julie (DevRel): Action items recap:
- ana: push perf csv + raw logs and create demo issues (due EOD tomorrow)
- maya: blog draft + H1 options (due tomorrow noon)
- ben: create landing + promo assets checklist, own run-of-show (start drafts)
- kevin: HubSpot workflow + hidden UTM fields (due in 48h)
- sara: quick legal check on bench claims (thumbs by EOD)
- julie: coordinate rehearsal & speaker notes, write developer sample tasks

sara (Legal): I'll review bench claims tonight. If any tweaks, will comment in the doc.

launch-bot: Calendar event created: "RefApp Lite Hacknight rehearsal" — May 24 17:00 UTC. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=FAKE

owen (Growth): Awesome. Let's keep the messaging tight: numbers + reproducibility + a clear CTA for engineers (clone + run bench). One more ask: can we produce a minimal Dockerfile for the demo so people can run locally? That will reduce friction.

ana/ana (Eng): Will add Dockerfile to demo-ready branch.

julie (DevRel): Perfect. I'll follow up with a short doc for breakout leads. Thanks team — please post updates in this thread as you complete items. :rocket:
